brands.name: Toy Boat Surfboards
brands.short_description: Toy Boat Surfboards is the personal shaping label of Santa Barbara surfer, sailor, and creative Trevor Gordon.

models.name: Flathead
models.description: The Flathead Fish is a purpose-designed board meant to be ridden 3 to 4 inches shorter than your traditional keel fish. It's designed for maximum sensitivity, lift, and drive—pared down into a small, efficient package. This isn’t your everyday, every-condition fish. The concept behind the polarizing nose design is that you get the rail line of a longer board for hold and drive while reducing the overall length of the board and its swing weight. Combined with the heavy single concave throughout the bottom and the pinched rails, you get tons of lift and a board that can bite the wave. If you’ve spent time on a mini Simmons or the like, this hybrid brings a super fun blend to the arena. The sweet spot is waist-high to slightly overhead surf with clean surface tension conditions and fast down-the-line waves.

models.name: VMG
models.description: The VMG is a traditional San Diego style fish with some adjustments. This isn’t a chunky bulky high volume fish. It's thinner overall, with foiled out nose and tail and mellower thin but rounded rails allowing it to hold tight to the wave when turning while still having plenty of float with easy rail to rail transitions. There is a little more curve throughout the back half when compared to a standard traditional fish. This board also works great in the barrel and can be done in a twin or a split keel type of quad. The bottom shape is a single to triplane forward. The VMG stretched up to 7’–10’ is the Lordship model.

models.name: Pluero
models.description: Short for Plueronectiform. Like a Halibut or any asymmetrical fish. This is a high performance short board whose template and design changes to the person and the purpose. More often than not the toe-side is straighter and the heal-side is curvier. The toe-side has more concave; the heal is more subtle. The toe side rail is thinner and the heal fuller. Two, three or four fins. Sometimes a symmetrical outline with an asymmetrical hull shape. Sizing is all over the map, from 2 inches below your height to a step up-mini gun size.

models.name: Baked Bean
models.description: The Baked Bean is an all-rounder high performance, fuller templated board that can be ridden in a ton of different sizes and all types of different waves and conditions. Similar to the VMG, it has a tri-plane style hull that allows for easy transitions and a go anywhere on the wave approach. Wide point centered and normally paired with a quad setup.

models.name: Willard
models.description: The Willard is the gap between a mid length and a glider style board. Designed for high speed trimming in the pocket while being quickly able to switch gears, turn and re-direct down the line. It has a rolly controlled feeling and a ton of speed while riding far up on the board. Ideal lengths between 7’6” and 8’4” and ridden as a single fin.
